Problem Statement
Read a character and print its ASCII (integer) value.
Description
Read a single character using scanf. Since a char is stored internally as a small integer, assign the character to an int variable and print that variable to obtain its ASCII value.
Input Description
A single character.
Output Description
Print the ASCII (integer) value of the character.

A
